password.heading: Change password
password.note: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

delete.heading: Delete account
delete.body: This removes your account from {{server}} and signs you out everywhere. It can't be undone.
delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.confirmBody: Enter your password to delete the account {{username}} for good.
delete.lastAdmin: You're the only admin, and this server needs one. Make someone else an admin first, then delete your account.

browsers.heading: Browsers
browsers.lead: Every browser where you're signed in to {{server}}.

others.none: No other browser was signed in.
others.failed: Couldn't sign out the other browsers. {{reason}}

everywhere.title: Log out everywhere?
everywhere.body: This signs you out in every browser and every linked app, this one included.

linked.heading: Linked devices
linked.empty: Nothing is linked yet. Apps you sign in to with this account, like the isshoni desktop app when it arrives, show up here.

download.title: Desktop app
download.coming: The isshoni desktop app is coming (Windows first). It keeps Discord and other voice apps out of what friends hear.
download.untilThen: Until then, share from Chrome or Edge: pick a Window and keep Share audio on.
